translated: Right, even at the airport on the way back—I flew home, by the way—
New Chitose Airport has so many shops selling soft-serve ice cream, so I picked out one really delicious one to eat.
I didn't know there were that many.
Man, I wouldn't be able to choose.
Now I want some shaved ice.
Our next piece of listener mail is from Hogu-san.
"If this mail is being read, I'm probably in the middle of desperately finishing my summer homework."
"I finished the time-consuming stuff like my independent research project early with my parents, but I'm sure I still haven't finished my workbooks."
"Are you two the type to get things done ahead of time?"
"Also, what were you like back when you were students?"
